visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a black and white maid uniform with a lace cat-ear headband stands on an asphalt street. Beside her is a person encased in a homemade traffic speed camera costume. The costume includes a tall pole, a silver camera box, a yellow sign with Chinese characters, and a large red triangular sign topped with a circular "190" limit sign. The background shows a large red brick building and parked vehicles under bright daylight. (2) The woman reaches out and touches the camera box component of the costume. She looks at the lens with an expectant smile. A collection of colorful exclamation mark graphics suddenly burst around her face to emphasize her surprise and excitement as she widens her eyes. The camera remains at eye-level, capturing her upper body and the costume in a medium shot. (3) The speed camera costume's lens area emits a bright, momentary white flash, mimicking the operation of a real traffic enforcement camera. The woman responds by smiling broadly, flashing a thumbs-up sign, and looking into the filming camera. The lighting is bright and natural, with sharp shadows on the ground indicating a sunny day. (4) The woman uses her hands to make a large "X" gesture, signaling "No," while laughing and speaking. She then gestures toward the camera costume with both hands, presenting it to the viewer as the scene cuts between different medium shots and close-ups.
